brief: A peaceful exploration theme for wandering through an enchanted forest, with gentle melodies and a sense of wonder

spec.description: A gentle, flowing orchestral piece with soft woodwind melodies drifting over lush string pads and delicate harp arpeggios, evoking the magical stillness of an enchanted forest. Shimmering bell tones and light pizzicato strings add a sense of discovery and childlike wonder, while a warm ambient undertone keeps the atmosphere serene and immersive.
spec.style_hint: Koji Kondo fairy-tale orchestral style, reminiscent of Zelda overworld exploration themes, SNES-to-modern era

brief: An intense, driving boss battle theme with heavy percussion, dramatic orchestral hits, and an aggressive tempo

spec.description: An intense, driving boss battle theme featuring thunderous taiko drums and heavy orchestral percussion, punctuated by dramatic brass and string hits that surge with relentless aggression. Driving low-end ostinatos on cello and bass push the tension forward while blaring horns and choir stabs amplify the sense of overwhelming danger. The atmosphere is ferocious and cinematic, built for a climactic confrontation.
spec.style_hint: Yoko Shimomura / Hitoshi Sakimoto epic orchestral boss battle style, reminiscent of Final Fantasy XII or Kingdom Hearts

brief: A nostalgic 8-bit chiptune town theme reminiscent of classic JRPG menu music, upbeat and catchy

spec.description: A bright and catchy 8-bit chiptune town theme with bouncy square wave melodies layered over a lively pulse wave bassline and crisp noise channel percussion. The music radiates warmth and nostalgia, evoking the feeling of wandering a peaceful RPG village, with loopable phrases and cheerful arpeggiated harmonies that feel instantly memorable.
spec.style_hint: NES/Famicom era JRPG, reminiscent of early Dragon Quest and Final Fantasy town themes by Koichi Sugiyama and Nobuo Uematsu
